title: Objective Thune: Le Secret de la Licorne

author.name: Jacques Favier and Philippe Ratte, published by PVH editions

prize.note: P2SH escrow, 2 funding transactions: 2020-01-03 (21,000,000 sats) and 2020-06-19 (21,000 sats)

target_format: 3 private keys, physically hidden in 3 of 210 numbered book copies; their public keys form a Bitcoin Core 0.18.1-style P2SH multisig redeem script (M-of-3, key order not sorted)

derivation.summary: rebuild OP_M <pk1> <pk2> <pk3> OP_3 OP_CHECKMULTISIG for every key order and every M from candidate public keys, hash160 the script, base58check-encode as P2SH, compare to the escrow
derivation.certified_against: a real, already-spent 2-of-3 P2SH multisig found on-chain (block 360000, transaction de5af572e195ecbd7ce715be0464f79cd720b1c540c23c07a9d4e23dd24f8e47), decoded directly from its scriptSig

difficulty_note: the mechanism is fully specified and the oracle is ready; what is missing is which 3 of the 210 physical book copies hold the keys, a physical fact, not a computation
